live_reentry.pre_result_main_message: trigger6: persist DoWhy WP507 native placebo E3 result

observed_concepts: SpanContext is immutable and carries TraceId/SpanId plus trace metadata
a span has zero or one semantic parent
Links may reference one or many causally related SpanContexts, including across traces
parent/context propagation and application truth are separate concerns
optional root run/job preserves chain origin
forwarded parent/root facets are convenience copies and source event remains full-information authority

maps: CellInput reentry_depth -> bounded re-entry depth already present
WorkspaceSelection frame and GRID plan triples -> existing version/digest fences
BroadcastEnvelope recipient_cell_ids -> only valid recipient set
BroadcastEnvelope is explicitly OFFERED_NOT_ACKED and not uptake/causal authority
existing tests already reject stale frame digest
existing tests preserve broadcast as offer rather than uptake/effect authority

why: F2 already has exact canonical frame, plan, selection, broadcast, cell and digest identities
WP508 needs a fail-closed re-entry provenance witness, not a second trace or lineage truth store
OTel contributes the useful one-parent-plus-many-links shape
OpenLineage contributes the useful parent/root authority rule and convenience-copy boundary

proposed_f2_native_witness.name: GwtReentryProvenanceWitness

lineage_shape.parent_ref: exact immediate F2 predecessor witness/broadcast-recipient binding; at most one
lineage_shape.root_ref: exact canonical chain-origin F2 event/frame witness; optional but immutable when present
lineage_shape.link_refs: zero or more additional exact F2 predecessor/contributor refs; never a substitute for parent/root
lineage_shape.external_trace_witness: optional opaque trace_id/span_id metadata for correlation only; no authority

proposed_f2_native_witness.identity_rule: canonical F2 IDs/digests determine validity; external trace/lineage IDs never repair, override, or mint a failed/missing canonical binding
proposed_f2_native_witness.copy_rule: forwarded parent/root summaries are projections for convenience; the referenced canonical F2 source object remains authority

fail_closed_test_matrix_for_next_stage.mutation: frame_generation or plan/broadcast generation differs while IDs remain plausible
recipient_cell_id not in exact BroadcastEnvelope.recipient_cell_ids or input belongs to another cell
parent/link/root ref cannot be resolved to an exact compatible canonical predecessor
same canonical re-entry observation is replayed under a fresh external trace/span ID
syntactically valid external trace/span lineage conflicts with canonical F2 generation/digest
copied root/parent summary differs from referenced canonical root/parent object

counterhypothesis.statement: Adding explicit parent/root/link witness structure merely duplicates existing F2 identifiers and increases schema surface without increasing discriminative power.
counterhypothesis.cheapest_falsifier: At E3, implement only a deterministic fixture/schema validator and show at least one WP508 negative case (cross-recipient, replay alias, or orphan-link) that current broadcast/selection validation alone cannot distinguish but the proposed witness can reject without external runtime dependencies. If no such case exists, retire the extra witness layer.

resource_assessment.full_otel_sdk_or_backend: NOT_RECOMMENDED_FOR_WP508_AT_E2; dependency/runtime/serialization/export overhead would be introduced and is unmeasured here
resource_assessment.full_openlineage_runtime: NOT_RECOMMENDED_FOR_WP508_AT_E2; would duplicate provenance transport/state concerns
resource_assessment.concept_distillation: PREFERRED; zero new runtime dependency by design, but latency/RSS/PSS/CPU/I/O impact is NOT_MEASURED_AT_E2
resource_assessment.license_risk: LOW_FOR_CONCEPT_DISTILL; both inspected upstream sources are Apache-2.0, but no upstream code is copied in this delta

hypothesis_fusion.preferred_hypothesis: A thin F2-native immutable re-entry witness using canonical F2 version/digest identities plus one-parent/many-links/root provenance semantics can improve WP508 falsifiability while preserving UnifiedDB/EntityOS authority and avoiding a second observability/lineage substrate.
hypothesis_fusion.falsifier: E3 fixture cannot reject any material WP508 negative that current canonical bindings cannot already reject, or requires external IDs to establish correctness.

next_exact_gate: E3_CLAIM_REPRODUCED: deterministic F2-native fixture/schema validator for the seven-case fail-closed matrix, with no OTEL/OpenLineage runtime dependency and zero runtime/GWT/J-Space credit until separately observed.
note: This result completes only the claimed E2 mapping. It does not implement WP508, run a target runtime, prove semantic uptake or causal influence, or authorize effects.
